issue.title: docs-check: Mac capture-panel, capture-previews, keyboard and plugins bob-navigation-hotkeys reference pages exceed the 6000-word cap
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-ji.7.1.1 (note #1) and bob-cli-ji.7.1.6 (note #1), and earlier by
bob-cli-ji.2 (note #1). Triaged by the bob-cli-ji.7.1 land agent. protocol.md is already
tracked by bob-cli-h9 and is left there.

## What fails

bob-cli `just docs-check` fails at lint on master 23e7f90d, with bob-mac-capture
1498f34 mounted from the linked checkout:

    docs/reference/mac-capture/capture-panel.md:1: budget: over budget at 6036 words (cap 6000 for reference/)
    docs/reference/mac-capture/capture-previews.md:1: budget: over budget at 6088 words (cap 6000 for reference/)
    docs/reference/mac-capture/keyboard.md:1: budget: over budget at 6097 words (cap 6000 for reference/)
    docs/reference/mac-capture/protocol.md:1: budget: over budget at 6217 words (cap 6000 for reference/)   <- bob-cli-h9
    docs/reference/plugins/bob-navigation-hotkeys.md:1: budget: over budget at 6132 words (cap 6000 for reference/)

Counts come from `bob_docs.markdown.count_words`. Before epic bob-cli-ji.7.1,
bob-mac-capture 62a7b70 was already over the cap: keyboard.md 6065, protocol.md 6149.
That epic's land work trims its own additions back to those counts. The remaining
overage is pre-existing.

Owning repositories:
- bob-mac-capture `docs/capture-panel.md`, `docs/capture-previews.md`, `docs/keyboard.md`
- bob-plugins `docs/bob-navigation-hotkeys.md` (mounted as reference/plugins/)

## Fix

Bring each page under 6000 words without dropping contract facts. Trim duplicated prose,
or move a coherent section into its own mounted reference page if docs memory and the IA
rules allow it, keeping published URLs. Then run each repo's `just docs-check` and
bob-cli `just docs-check` with the siblings mounted.
